drawings.notes: Five pencil sketches, left to right and top to bottom: an open quadrilateral (three sides, a tick at the free end); a crossed quadrilateral in Z; lines through four points, two of them thickened; a trapezoid with its two diagonals and a vertical stroke from a dot on the top side; a flattened quadrilateral with its diagonals (bottom left, with a faint stroke under it). drawings.description: figure : le quadrilatère de côtés $u_0, u_1, u_2, u_3$ et ses deux diagonales fléchées
drawings.notes: Quadrilateral with sides u0 (top left), u1 (top right, arrowed into the right vertex), u2 (bottom right), u3 (bottom left, a separate stroke that does not close the figure), and its two diagonals arrowed (horizontal one to the left, vertical one upwards). A stray dot below the figure is left out. The transcription locates this figure correctly; the other sketches of the page (two lines with s0, s2, s3 at the top; vectors u, v and a pentagon with all its diagonals at the bottom) are covered by notes, not marks.

drawings.description: figure : quatre côtés consécutifs $u_{i-2}, \ldots, u_{i+1}$ annotés à l'extérieur des $\lambda_{i-2}, \ldots, \lambda_{i+1}$ et, aux sommets à l'intérieur, des $\delta_{i-1}, \ldots, \delta_{i+2}$, avec des ratures
drawings.notes: Labels corrected 2026-11-13 after the editor's answer (#150: « No »). Geometry unchanged: four consecutive sides, u_{i-2} (faint, slightly curved, arrowed at its free end), u_{i-1}, u_i, u_{i+1}, joined at their vertices (the 2026-11-12 settling), no dots at the vertices. Inside the polygon, at the vertices, the labels are deltas, not lambdas: delta_{i+2} at the top of u_{i+1} and delta_{i+1} at the vertex u_i / u_{i+1} on the right inner side, as the editor reads them; by the same hand, delta_{i-1} at the vertex u_{i-2} / u_{i-1} and delta_i (overinked) at the vertex u_{i-1} / u_i. Outside: lambda_{i-2} by the arrow tip, lambda_{i-1} u_{i-2} at the left, lambda_{i-1} under the bottom side left of u_{i-1} (the label asked about in #128: the editor reads lambda_{i-1}, not lambda_{i+1}; its sign is blotted on the page), lambda_i under the vertex u_{i-1} / u_i (its index overinked), u_i, lambda_{i+1} at the right, u_{i+1}. The editor's note is cut at fifteen words (« … missing lambda_{i-1}, lambda_i … »): every label the page shows is now drawn. Left out: the struck marks along u_{i-2} and u_{i-1} (overwritten indices), the u and V above the figure and the long faint stroke crossing the top, which belong to the text. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour crop: strokes within a stroke's width, labels on their glyphs. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): the redraw made after the editor's answer in #150 is kept unchanged; not compiled (no TeX in the session), rasterised and laid over the 350 dpi colour render of the scan again: the four sides lie on the ink within a stroke's width and every label on its glyphs, as the editor reads them. The marks left out are the struck ones along u_{i-2} and u_{i-1} (crossings-out, not part of the figure) and the u, V and long faint stroke above, which belong to the text.

drawings.description: en marge gauche, une figure : la droite $d_{n-2}$ par $s_{n-2}$ et $s_{n-1}$, la droite $d_{n-1}$, verticale et en tirets, par $s_{n-1}$ et $s_0$, la droite $d_0$ par $s_0$ et $s_1$, la droite $d_1$ par $s_1$ et $s_2$ ; chaque droite dépasse les sommets qu'elle joint.
drawings.kind: four lines of a polygon with its vertices
drawings.notes: As on the page: the lines d_{n-2}, d_{n-1} (dashed), d_0 and d_1, each drawn through its two computed vertices and running on beyond them; the vertices s_{n-2}, s_{n-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2 marked and labelled; the names of the lines beside them; a short cross stroke at s_{n-2}. Left out: a small curved stroke along d_{n-1} just under s_{n-1} (a retouch). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: plus bas, deux croquis de dégénérescences : à gauche, $s_0$, $s_1$ et $s_2 = s_3$ alignés, les segments notés $d_0$ et $d_1$, avec en dessous « \uncertain{$u\,d_{12}$} » ; à droite, deux droites sécantes, leur point commun marqué, portant chacune un point cerclé.
drawings.kind: two degenerate configurations: three aligned vertices; two crossing lines with ringed points
drawings.notes: Left: the broken line s_0, s_1, s_2 = s_3 (nearly straight), its three points and the labels s_0, d_0, s_1, d_1, s_2 = s_3 under it. Right: two lines through one computed crossing point, marked, each carrying one ringed point. Left out: the words under the first sketch, which the transcription gives as uncertain, and the formula of the text below. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: plus bas encore, un triangle vu comme hexagone dégénéré : sommets $s_0 = s_1$, $s_2 = s_3$, $s_4 = s_5$, côtés $d_0 = d_1$ (en bas), $d_2 = d_3$ (à droite), $d_4 = d_5$ (à gauche, épaissi).

Nothing left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en tête, une figure : $s_0$ et $s_2$ sur une droite horizontale fléchée à droite, $s_1$ et $s_3$ sur une droite oblique qui la coupe entre $s_0$ et $s_2$.

Each line is drawn through its computed points. A short stroke beside the top of the oblique line is left out. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour crop on 2026-11-12: the right end of the horizontal line raised 2 mm, where it stands; the rest within 1 mm. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.kind: two consecutive vectors u, v; pentagon with all its diagonals

Left out: the struck formula under the vectors. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en tête, à gauche, une figure : un polygone non convexe à neuf sommets $s_0, \ldots, s_8$, de côtés $u_0, \ldots, u_7$ (le neuvième côté, de $s_8$ à $s_0$, sans lettre), avec des traits fins de $s_0$ vers $s_2$, $s_4$ et $s_7$.
drawings.notes: As on the page: the nine vertices computed once and every side drawn between them; the sides s_0 s_1, s_4 s_5 and s_6 s_7 heavy as on the page; thin segments from s_0 to s_4 and to s_7, and a thin one towards s_2 that stops short of it; the closing side s_8 s_0 thin (he drew it twice). Labels s_0 ... s_8 and u_0 ... u_7 where he wrote them (u_0 is written under the side s_0 s_1, beside the thin segment to s_7; s_4 and s_7 are written over earlier letters). Left out: a stray « s » left of s_4 and the doubling of the long side u_5. The transcription's note says segments go from s_0 to the other vertices: only those to s_2, s_4, s_7 (and the side to s_8) are drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says segments join s_0 to the other vertices; only those towards s_2, s_4 and s_7 are drawn, besides the sides.

drawings.description: en tête, à gauche, une figure : un pentagone $s_0 s_1 s_2 s_3 s_4$ dont les cinq côtés $u_0, \ldots, u_4$ sont fléchés dans le sens du parcours.
drawings.notes: As on the page: the five sides drawn as five separate arrows, each with its head at its end (u_0 from s_0 to s_1, and so on round to u_4 from s_4 back to s_0), leaving the gaps he left at s_1, s_2, s_3 and s_4 (2 to 4 mm), and the ten labels where he wrote them, outside the pentagon. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour crop on 2026-11-12: the earlier redraw joined the arrows at five computed vertices; they are now drawn where they stand, gaps included. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en marge gauche, au bas de la page, trois croquis. En haut, sans lettres, quatre traits qui se suivent, les trois premiers fléchés, un point marqué entre le deuxième et le troisième. Au milieu, un polygone ouvert de sommets $s_{n-1}$, $s_0$, $s_1$, $s_2$, $s_3$, le dernier côté courbe. En bas, un $n$-gone ouvert en haut : $s_{n-4}$, $s_{n-3}$, $s_{n-2}$, $s_{n-1}$, $s_0$, $s_1$, $s_2$, $s_3$, $s_4$, de côtés $u_{n-4}$, $u_{n-3}$, $u_{n-2}$, $u_{n-1}$, $u_0$, $u_1$, $u_2$, $u_3$.
drawings.kind: three sketches of polygons with named vertices and sides
drawings.notes: Top: four consecutive strokes (down to the right, two horizontal ones separated by a full point, up to the right), arrowheads on the first three; no letters. Middle: the open polygon s_{n-1} (small open point), s_0, s_1, s_2 (full point), then a side up to the left and a curved stroke beyond it, with the label s_3 above; the label under s_0 is written over a struck letter. Bottom: the n-gon, open at the top between s_{n-4} and s_3/s_4: vertices computed once, the side u_{n-1} arrowed into s_0, s_2 a full point; vertex and side labels where he wrote them. Still differs: in the middle sketch the place of s_3 is not marked on the page (the label stands above the gap between the last side and the curved stroke) and the two are drawn as he left them; in the bottom sketch the labels u_{n-2} and u_{n-1} are small and read after the sequence. The transcription's note speaks of a pentagon s_0, ..., s_4: the middle sketch carries s_{n-1}, s_0, s_1, s_2, s_3. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ rasterised and laid over the 350 dpi colour render of the scan, with a contrast-enhanced crop of the middle sketch. The top and bottom sketches lie on the ink to within about 1 unit and were kept. Middle sketch corrected: the side from s_{n-1} stops 2 units short of s_0, as on the page (it was drawn to the point); the point at s_{n-1} is a full point (an inked blot at 400 dpi, not an open one); the side from s_1 up to s_2 follows its ink and stops just under the point s_2; s_0 and s_3 placed on their ink. The middle sketch is drawn as he left it: the label s_3 stands above the gap between the last side and the curved stroke, with no point there. The labels of the bottom sketch, small for u_{n-2} and u_{n-1}, stand on their glyphs.

drawings.notes: The broken line s0 s1 s2 s3 with arrowed sides u0 ... u3, u0 and u3 horizontal, as the transcription says.
